summary: Canonical governing source requires executing agents to report material process problems promptly when progress blocks, incorrect effects or acceptance are at risk, or substantial avoidable work occurs. Existing review completion, worker return and handoff boundaries check for unreported problems without inventing findings or repeating unchanged reports. Reports separate observation from hypothesis and include bounded evidence, delivery impact, workaround and a proposed improvement when known; a missing solution does not suppress a valid report. Root ensures reasoned repair/current-work attachment/canonical intake/investigate/defer/decline disposition while preserving direct owner disposal and independent reviewers rights. Unresolved findings retain owner, next action and reconsideration condition in existing owning issues/PRs. Accepted improvements define proportionate verification; Atlas captures reusable verified lessons or retains a capture gap/owner. show-progress summarizes existing owned findings and decisions. No separate reporting worker, mandatory packet, duplicate ledger, automatic filing, measurement campaign or recurring unchanged report follows. Reporting/disposition grants no dispatch, reservation release, uncertain-effect retry, Status write, weaker acceptance or closure authority. The cited source candidate received independent source review and maintained mirror/receiver-safe link validation. Required CI, genuine ordinary demonstration, source delivery and applicable published/installed instruction adoption remain separate; no operational or fleet acceptance is claimed.
title: Proactive process reporting uses existing owned finding disposition
